name: PT Saraswanti Anugerah Makmur, Tbk
summary: PT Saraswanti Anugerah Makmur, Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and distribution of non-subsidized NPK Fertilizers in Indonesia. It offers fertilizer products, such as palm oil, various crops, sugarcane, rubber, and coffee and cocoa under the FERTINDO, PUPINDO, DUPAN, PHONIKA, PLANTA PLUS, CORNALET, HALEI, PUKALET, KOKA, and PALMO brands. PT Saraswanti Anugerah Makmur, Tbk was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Surabaya, Indonesia. PT Saraswanti Anugerah Makmur, Tbk operates as a subsidiary of Pt Saraswanti Utama.
